snapshot_read.row_selection_limit: rightmost returned batch occurrence only; no active-state, lifecycle, first-seen, withdrawal or reappearance claim

proxy_rule.FLAT_OR_UNRESOLVED_PROXY: yConfirm == y or either value missing

decision_rationale: rb and hc are the only pair with the same large-scale geometric proxy: HIGH_CONFIRMED_PROXY.

Their latest returned mid-scale occurrences have the same HIGH_CONFIRMED_PROXY sign and both are shallow; the snapshot supplies no cross-symbol mid-scale state difference strong enough to select or rank one.
i has LOW_CONFIRMED_PROXY on both large and mid scales and is not a same-background comparator for rb/hc.
Using the larger rb-versus-hc big-scale confirmation magnitude difference to force a ranking would answer a different question and would not establish independent mid-scale selection information.

target_process.name: RELATIVE_RESILIENCE_WITHIN_COMMON_BIG_HIGH_PROXY_PAIR
target_process.business_meaning: During the held-out tail, one member would show a higher close path from the cutoff and a smaller adverse excursion than the other.
target_process.decision_use: No member selected because the as-of mid-scale snapshot did not differentiate them.

future_evaluation_plan_frozen.base: each symbol close at or immediately corresponding to the fixed cutoff
metrics: minimum close return from cutoff within tail
maximum close return from cutoff within tail
rb-minus-hc normalized close path and terminal gap
future_evaluation_plan_frozen.case_only_material_separation: absolute terminal return gap >= 5 percentage points OR absolute difference in minimum tail return >= 5 percentage points

interpretation.no_material_separation: supports the conservative no-candidate disposition for this snapshot
interpretation.material_separation: shows a missed ex-post differentiation and challenges the sufficiency of latest-occurrence mid proxy; it does not authorize retroactive selection
interpretation.i_outcome: diagnostic only because i was excluded by non-comparable large-scale background

prohibitions: Do not treat event_ts, xConfirm, bar time or calendar alternate as native object first-known time.
Do not treat geometric proxy as formal upstream direction.
Do not infer lifecycle or active-state semantics from final rows.
Do not change cutoff, symbols, scales, parameters or target process after viewing the held-out tail.
